title: Happy puppy
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='16' ry='9' fill='#f7d9a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='24' fill='#e8b06a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='30' rx='9' ry='15' fill='#c98944' transform='rotate(-25 28 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='30' rx='9' ry='15' fill='#c98944' transform='rotate(25 72 30)'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='31' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#f0a0a0' transform='rotate(-25 28 31)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='31' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#f0a0a0' transform='rotate(25 72 31)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#f7d9a8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='38.5' r='1.6' fill='#fff7e0'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='38.5' r='1.6' fill='#fff7e0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='5' ry='3.8' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='48.6' cy='47' rx='1.4' ry='1' fill='#6a5a4a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 52 Q50 58 44 57' stroke='#3a2a1a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 52 Q50 58 56 57' stroke='#3a2a1a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='59' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#f07a8a'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='84' width='8' height='10' rx='4' fill='#c98944'/>
  <rect x='58' y='84' width='8' height='10' rx='4' fill='#c98944'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M76 70 Q88 62 84 52' stroke='#c98944' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
